status: Bounded Admin company-administration Organization read cutover. The Admin organization page and Admin technology API now consume the existing native Organization owner port when ERPX_NATIVE_ORGANIZATION_CONFIG is configured, while Brand identity and IAM assignment reads already use their owner-native ports. This slice adds no Rust, schema, composition or dependency change and does not claim browser verification.

workflowsConsidered.admin:company-brand-organization-iam: advanced: Organization owner read is now native on the Admin company-administration page/API; Brand identity and IAM assignment reads were already native in this worktree.
workflowsConsidered.admin:platform-only-entry: unchanged: current Platform authority and Manage ERPX remain in the Platform Administration slice.
workflowsConsidered.admin:provider-authority-separation: unchanged: Provider/Platform Commercial authority remains retained.

scope.surface: Admin Company Administration -> Technology -> Organization (/holdings/[holdingSlug]/administration/technology/organization) and GET /api/v1/holdings/[holdingSlug]/technology/organization.
scope.nativeOwnerReuse: The Admin surface reuses the existing Organization owner HTTP read through ERPX_NATIVE_ORGANIZATION_CONFIG. No cross-owner SQL, no new Rust owner crate, no new route in src/composition and no new environment variable were added.
scope.composition: Native Organization supplies the Company-scoped node tree, positions and staff levels. The retained Admin read remains authoritative for People rows, private-field redaction, canMovePeople and the Company-manage ceiling (native canManage can only narrow, never raise, the retained value). Positions are accepted only when active and exactly within the selected Branch/Department scope.
scope.failClosed: A native actor or Company mismatch, duplicate node/position/level identity, malformed row, changed Holding context or configured owner failure is mapped to a bounded ApiError and never silently replaced by the retained organization projection. Unset native configuration keeps the explicit retained TypeScript page/API path; the existing Organization native read requires people.manage, so actors without that permission keep the retained read instead of receiving a broken configured page.
scope.brandAndIam: Brand identity already reads through the native Brand owner transport and IAM assignment rows already read through the native Identity Access transport in this worktree. Those owner slices were not changed.
scope.notClaimed: No authenticated browser page, shared composition mount, Admin home/settings/user-account dashboard, new Rust owner workflow, schema migration or deployment was performed.
